selection_policy: Formal selected attempt only. Recorded main FAIL, exclude confirmed completion, substantive prior review, known dispute and missing basic logs. Main scores untouched; adjudications used only as eligibility/evidence boundaries.
old_manifest_search: No v1/v2/v3 sampling manifest or additional_reviews found under local analysis directory before first draw.
algorithm: Python random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(unique JSON [baseline, task_id, selected_attempt] keys), min(50, pool size)); independent baseline seeds; no replacement

scope_limitations: This is the unreviewed available recorded-failure pool, not all failures or all Core200 tasks.
Equal baseline quotas are not proportional sampling of total failures.
No selection by old failure label, keyword, expected theme, device group, termination or task family.
Retain every selected record after review even if scoring question or evidence-limited; do not replace to support hypotheses.
Manifest family is a source cohort, often a device grouping; independence of semantic templates remains unknown.
Existing targeted cases and success controls do not count toward the 50 quota.
